description: Single voice per selection: A selection (event or range) belongs to EXACTLY ONE voice (voiceIndex: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4). Range selection across voices is rejected.
testName: range-selects across m.1 and m.2 strictly in voice 2, excluding voice 1 notes

description: Range measure span: Range selection across measures in the same voice is supported; returns start/end measure numbers, count of events, and measureCount.
testName: range-selects across m.1 and m.2 strictly in voice 2, excluding voice 1 notes

description: Cross-voice paste auto-creation: Pasting into a voice that does not exist in the target measure auto-creates the voice with D3 semantics in the same undo step (rests fill [0, totalMTicks) via fillMeasureWithRests, sorted by voiceIndex).
testName: b) copy 2 notes from voice 2, paste into voice 2 of a measure with ONLY voice 1 -> voice 2 created in 1 undo step, surrounded by rests

description: Voice isolation of operations: Operations on a voice selection (transpose, delete/convert-to-rest, tie, slur, articulation, dynamic) touch only the selected voice and leave other voices untouched.
Status bar range info: Shows count and measure span in active locale ({count} öge seçildi ({measures}) / {count} items selected ({measures})).
testName: renders Turkish range selection info with count and measure span: 8 öge seçildi (Ölçü 1–2)

description: Marquee single voice resolution: Marquee drag encloses notes of both voices but selects ONLY the voice of the first-hit event without voiceId.
testName: T6: marquee enclosing notes of BOTH voices selects ONLY voice of the first-hit event without voiceId

description: Memory and system clipboard: Copy and paste preserve notes and rests with voiceIndex; system clipboard serialization and deserialization without voiceId.
testName: a) copy 2 notes from voice 2, paste into voice 1 of measure 1 -> pasted notes in voice 1, voice 2 unchanged

description: Undo/redo deep-equality: Every operation, paste, and delete on voice selections is fully reversible, restoring score deep-equal to initial with 0 validation errors.
Property-based fuzz verification: 20 seeds x 100 steps of random voice range selection, transposition, clipboard, and deletion with invariant checking and reversibility.
testName: verifies 20 seeds x 100 steps of random voice operations, isolation, and undo/redo reversibility

description: Range selection across m.1-2 in voice 2 on BWV 140/7 constructed via real app path; asserts isolation, measure span, and extendSelection.
testName: range-selects across m.1 and m.2 strictly in voice 2, excluding voice 1 notes

description: Transpose voice 2 selection semitone down (-1); voice 1 untouched, voice 2 changed, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
Transpose voice 2 selection octave up (+12); voice 1 untouched, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
Transpose voice 2 selection octave down (-12); voice 1 untouched, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
Toggle tie on two adjacent same-pitch notes in voice 2; voice 1 untouched, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
testName: tie (toggleTie on two adjacent same-pitch notes in voice 2)

description: Toggle slur across voice 2 notes; voice 1 untouched, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
Toggle articulation staccato on voice 2 range; voice 1 untouched, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
Set dynamic mf on voice 2 range; voice 1 untouched, undo restores score deep-equal to initial.
Cross-voice paste into voice 2 that already has content; replaces content, leaves other voices untouched, validateScore zero errors.
testName: c) copy 2 notes from voice 2, paste into voice 2 that already has content -> replaces content, validateScore 0 errors

description: Marquee enclosing notes of both voices selects ONLY the voice of the first-hit event without voiceId.
testName: T6: marquee enclosing notes of BOTH voices selects ONLY voice of the first-hit event without voiceId
